about.our_story: MANUU Connect is run by students and alumni who believe in empowering the next generation of tech leaders. As current students graduate, they pass the platform to upcoming students, ensuring continuous growth and fresh perspectives in the community.
about.mission: To create a sustainable student-led ecosystem where knowledge flows from seniors to juniors, ensuring every MANUU student has opportunities to grow. By students, for students, MANUU Connect maintains this legacy by training future leaders to carry the platform forward.

core_values.community_first: Building a supportive network of CS/IT students at MANUU.
core_values.skill_development: Hands-on experience through hackathons and real projects.
core_values.innovation_hub: Exploring cutting-edge technologies and creative solutions.
core_values.career_growth: Preparing students for successful careers in tech.
